meta.title: AI assistant — chat about market prices
meta.description: Ask in plain words about prices, the cost of a recipe or basket, forecasts and the cheapest offers. Every number comes from the platform's data.

title: Your market price assistant
description: Write in plain words and follow up: “And in Andijan?”. Every number in an answer comes from prices on the platform.
label: Your question

examples.price: How much are onions in Namangan?
examples.basket: How much does plov for 10 people cost?
examples.movers: What got more expensive this week?
examples.cheapest: Which region has the cheapest meat?
examples.help: How do I post a price?

status.insufficient_dataHint: There are too few prices for this question (fewer than 3). We don't guess — try another area or period.
status.no_productHint: Name a product from the catalog in your question, for example: onion, potato, apple.

source.basedOn: {count, plural, one {based on # price} other {based on # prices}}

failed: Couldn't get an answer. Please try again shortly.
rateLimited: Too many questions. Please try again in a minute.
disclaimer: The answer is based on the platform's listings and price history; it is not financial advice.
tableToggle: Table · {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}

chat.welcomeTitle: What would you like to know?
chat.welcomeText: Prices, where it's cheaper, the cost of a recipe or basket, forecasts — ask in plain words. It remembers the previous question when you follow up.
chat.forwarded: We've passed this question to our team and will use it to improve the assistant.
chat.busy: AI is busy right now; a simpler answer was given.
chat.offTitle: The assistant is not available yet
chat.offText: Please try again later. You can see prices in the catalog and on the statistics pages.
chat.invalid: A message must be 1 to {max} characters.
chat.shortcut: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line

actions.signInFirst: Sign in with Telegram first. You'll come back here afterwards.
actions.watchSaved: Watch added. The bot will tell you when the price drops.

watch_price.title: Watch the price
watch_price.description: We'll message you through the Telegram bot when the price drops or a cheaper offer appears.

create_request.title: Send a price request
